# Third-Party Code

This directory contains third-party or lightly modified support code that is
kept separate from the SCFields implementation:

- `d3fields_dev/`: D3Fields support code and selected semantic feature references.
- `gsrobotics/`: GelSight Mini support utilities.
- `GelsightKCL/`: GelSight marker-tracking extension.
- `isaacgymenvs/`: upstream IsaacGymEnvs license/setup notices. The release
  keeps the modified TacSL/IsaacGymEnvs source at the repository root because it
  is part of the reproduced simulation pipeline.

Do not remove or rewrite third-party license notices when publishing.
